notes: Encoded ONLY from First Co.'s own page. All three page styles shipped. Year-letter cycle is stated in page text (not chart-only): A = 1971 and 1994 and 2017, B = 1972 & 1995 & 2018, C = 1973 & 1996 & 2019, D = 1974 & 1997 & 2020, E = 1975 & 1998 & 2021, F = 1976 & 1999 & 2022, G = 1977 & 2000 & 2023, etc.; letters I, O, Q not used; the page cautions that other factors must determine the decade. Candidate lists are bounded to years up to the current year (2026): letters A-K carry three candidates, letters L-Z carry two, because their third-cycle years (2027+) are in the future and cannot apply to an existing unit. Style 3 ships year-only: the page states only the year positions and does not state that the following digits are a month, so no month is inferred.

styles.era: 10-character serials: letter, 2 month digits, letter, 6 digits
styles.notes: Page: year = 1st position letter (cycle table, see brand notes); month = 2nd & 3rd positions digits. Example S05... decodes to month 05 (May) and S -> [1986, 2009] (third-cycle 2032 withheld as future).

styles.era: 17-character serials: letter, 2 month digits, 2 letters, 12 digits
styles.notes: Page: year = 1st position letter (same cycle table as style-1); month = 2nd & 3rd positions digits. Page note: the serial may be split across two lines on the data plate with the first 3 characters above the rest; normalization strips the spaces. Example F05... decodes to month 05 (May) and F -> [1976, 1999, 2022]. Pattern is disjoint from style-1 (17 vs 10 characters).

styles.era: 8-character serials (space/dash in raw form), year only
styles.notes: Page: year = 1st two positions of the serial number. Example decodes 24 -> 2024 (1924 below the 1960 floor, so unambiguous). No month is stated on the page, so none is encoded even though the raw form contains '08' after the year.
